audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Receipt encoding/decoding with transaction type prefixes is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL transaction or receipt handling. The encode_receipt function does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Exhaustive type handling in encode_receipt for five transaction types (AccessList, FeeMarket, Blob, SetCode, Legacy) is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL transaction or receipt encoding. The encode_receipt function does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Transaction type hierarchy and isinstance check ordering for receipt encoding is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL transaction types (SetCodeTransaction, AccessListTransaction, etc.). These transaction classes do not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: LegacyTransaction receipt encoding without type prefix or RLP wrapping is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL transaction types or receipt encoding. LegacyTransaction does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Receipt decoding with prefix stripping and RLP decoding is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL receipt decoding. The decode_receipt function does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: RLP decoder handling of malformed inputs in receipt decoding is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. While Prysm uses RLP encoding for some CL data structures, it does not implement EL receipt decoding or the specific RLP validation context described (receipts with type prefixes via P2P). The decode_receipt function does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Size limits before RLP decoding of receipts is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL receipt decoding or the specific size validation context described (receipts based on gas limits via P2P). The decode_receipt function does not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Cross-type receipt spoofing detection (e.g., SetCode prefix with FeeMarket body) is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL receipt validation or transaction type verification. The decode_receipt function and transaction type classes do not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Verifying encode_receipt and decode_receipt are inverse operations is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL receipt encoding/decoding. These functions do not exist in Prysm codebase.

Component mismatch: Validation of non-constant difficulty and non-zero nonce in post-merge blocks is an Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) concept. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client. While Prysm validates execution payloads post-merge, it does not directly validate EL-specific fields like difficulty and nonce in the same way an EL client would. These are EL block header fields that the CL receives as part of execution payloads but does not validate in the manner described (rejecting specific values via P2P). The CL trusts the EL to produce valid execution payloads.
